sloka: लघुस्सम्प्रति निर्मांस स्तृणभूतश्च राघव ।परिश्रान्तेन मत्तेन भ्रात्रा मे वालिना तदा ।क्षिप्तमेवं प्रहर्षेण भवता रघुनन्दन ॥४-११-८८॥।।
transliteration: laghussamprati nirmāṁsa stṛṇabhūtaśca rāghava ।pariśrāntena mattena bhrātrā me vālinā tadā ।kṣiptamevaṁ praharṣeṇa bhavatā raghunandana ॥4-11-88॥।।

translations.english: 'O friend, when Vali my brother flung the body, he was tired and intoxicated and the body was fresh with flesh (meaning heavy), but now, O Delight of the Raghu race, it is fleshless and light like a bunch of (dry) grass (for) which you could throw it playfully.
